newsitem.title: GERMANY: Daimler software unit sees strong growth.
newsitem.headline: Daimler software unit sees strong growth.

text.p: Software house debis Systemhaus GmbH, a subsidiary of Daimler-Benz AG, said on Tuesday it expected double-digit percentage growth in sales and earnings in 1997.
Debis Systemhaus in 1996 increased its revenue to 2.397 billion marks from 1.999 billion and operating profit under U.S. GAAP rose to 74 million marks from 25 million.
"We have set ourselves double digit targets for 1997 as well," debis Systemhaus managing director Karl Heinz Achinger told a news conference.
He said the main goal in 1997 was to expand abroad. In the first quarter subsidiaries were set up in Spain, the U.S. and South Africa and more will follow in Japan and Brazil.
"In the year 2001 sales in our international business should account for a third of our overall turnover," Achinger said. Foreign sales in 1996 totalled 300 million marks.
